subject.title: fix(ui): create named Control UI chat sessions

question: Should Control UI permanently interpret every non-empty `/new <text>` argument as a session label while other chat surfaces retain `/new <model>` semantics?
rationale: The implementation can safely support this behavior, but choosing a surface-specific grammar and selecting between the overlapping proposals requires maintainer product intent.

options.title: Close pending sponsorship
options.body: Close this technically sound proposal until a maintainer explicitly sponsors this Control UI-specific command contract or a consolidated alternative.

options.title: Sponsor this grammar
options.body: Approve Control UI `/new <text>` as labeling, keep model changes on `/model`, and reopen or retain this implementation.

options.title: Require explicit naming syntax
options.body: Preserve model-looking arguments and use an unambiguous form such as `/new --name <title>` in a narrowed replacement.

recommendation.title: Close pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Close this technically sound proposal until a maintainer explicitly sponsors this Control UI-specific command contract or a consolidated alternative.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows ownership across the affected Control UI, native Codex session, and adjacent chat-session surfaces, and the contributor explicitly requested this person's UX decision.
